items.title: Diagnose + fix the hang in review-pass-discard-smoke and init-window-data-loss-smoke
items.context: Trace each step (instrument or run sub-sections) to find where each smoke blocks past 300s with no output; fix so both complete deterministically. story_create via dist/cli.js in an isolated temp repo is already verified fast, so look at later spawns / git operations / lock waits.

items.title: Harden validate with a per-command bounded timeout (fail-loud, not silent force-exit)
items.context: In the validate runner, give each configured command a bounded timeout; on timeout mark THAT command failed with its label (so DONE reports a clear validate FAIL) instead of the current 300s no-output watchdog that force-exits the whole suite and leaves test-evidence.materialHash unstamped.
